newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler wins $60 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler wins $60 million contract.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Energy International Inc said on Wednesday that it had been awarded a $60 million contract by the Polish power company Elektrownia Jaworzno III S.A. to supply two boilers to its power plant in Jaworzno, Poland.

The contract, awarded to Foster Wheeler's operating companies Foster Wheeler Energy FAKOP Ltd in Poland, and Foster Wheeler Energia Oy in Finland, will supply two coal-waste-fired 70 MWe CFB boilers on a turnkey basis, the company said in a statement.
The new boilers will replace two existing pulverized-coal-fired boilers and will reduce emissions in the area, Foster Wheeler added.
The project, scheduled to start immediately,is expected to be completed late in 1999, it said.
U.S.-based Foster Wheeler designs and fabricates steam-generating equipment for electric utilities, industrial users and public authorities.
